rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — that means a lot, and genuinely good timing. I'm doing some quiet scoping right now on a first concrete project (small, evals-flavored, nothing announced yet), and once it's scoped there will likely be real work that fits \"a few spare hours a week\" well — things like building and scoring test scenarios, or sanity-checking results. I don't want to hand you something half-formed, so give me a bit to get the shape of it right. I'll follow up directly once there's a concrete task. If you want to compare notes before then, happy to do a short call. Thanks again for reaching out. Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (meetup volunteer) to keep her warm without committing to anything yet.
